creator: Alexander Terp
description:
The gate runs on macOS and stops there. The corpus diff against the container's daemon needs only docker and python3 - no Rust, Swift or Zig - so it is the cheapest second job there could be, and it is what catches a herdr re-pin that changes behavior on one platform and not the other.

Blocked on nothing now that ./dev --ssh exists; what a workflow adds is building the devenv image on a runner and caching it, since the image downloads a pinned herdr of its own.
title: 🐧 Run the Linux corpus diff in CI
